name: @velt-js/mcp-installer

tools.name: take_project_screenshot
tools.description: Takes a screenshot of the user's running Next.js application. WORKFLOW: This tool should be called FIRST in the Velt installation workflow to help identify where to add comments. REQUIREMENTS: 1) The user must have their Next.js dev server running (npm run dev) on localhost:3000 or another port. 2) After taking the screenshot, you should show it to the user and ask them to describe which part of their webpage they want to add comments to (e.g., "header", "sidebar", "main content area"). 3) Then ask them which type of comments they want: Freestyle (click anywhere) or Popover (attached to specific elements). 4) Use the detect_comment_placement tool with their responses to find the best files to modify. 5) Finally, use install_velt_freestyle or another installation tool to implement the selected comment type.

fullPage.description: Capture full page or just viewport (default: false)

tools.name: detect_comment_placement
tools.description: Analyzes the Next.js project structure to determine the best files and locations for placing Velt comments. WORKFLOW: This tool should be called AFTER taking a screenshot and getting user input about where they want comments. INPUT: Use the user's description of the target area (e.g., "header", "sidebar", "main content") and comment type (freestyle or popover). OUTPUT: Returns ranked list of candidate files with implementation guidance. USAGE: 1) Pass the targetDescription from what the user said about the screenshot 2) Pass the commentType based on user's choice (freestyle or popover) 3) Review the results with the user before proceeding to installation 4) Use the recommended placement information when calling installation tools

projectPath.description: Path to the Next.js project directory

commentType.description: Type of comments to implement (freestyle or popover)

targetDescription.description: User's description of where to add comments (e.g., "header", "sidebar", "main content area"). This comes from the user's response when you showed them the screenshot.

targetComponent.description: Optional: specific component name if the user mentioned it

tools.name: install_velt_interactive
tools.description:
🌟 RECOMMENDED: Unified Velt installation with guided or CLI-only mode. 

📚 REQUIRED: Velt Agent Skills must be installed.
Skills provide ALL implementation patterns. Without them, this tool cannot generate a working plan.
Do NOT use Velt Docs MCP as a substitute for skills.
Skills: velt-setup-best-practices, velt-comments-best-practices, velt-crdt-best-practices, velt-notifications-best-practices, velt-recorder-best-practices, velt-presence-best-practices, velt-cursors-best-practices, velt-huddle-best-practices, velt-single-editor-mode-best-practices, velt-self-hosting-data-best-practices, velt-activity-best-practices
The generated plan tells the AI which skill files to READ before each implementation step.

🚨🚨🚨 CRITICAL: ASK QUESTIONS ONE AT A TIME 🚨🚨🚨
DO NOT dump all questions in one message.
Wait for user response before asking the next question.
If the user skips a question, INFORM them of the default value being used (e.g., "Using default: freestyle comments") before proceeding.

=========================================
WORKFLOW - ASK ONE QUESTION, WAIT, THEN NEXT:
=========================================

STEP 1 - CONFIRM DIRECTORY:
  Ask ONLY: "Is this the correct project directory: [path]?"
  WAIT for user to confirm (yes/no).

STEP 2 - GET API KEY:
  Ask ONLY: "Please provide your Velt API Key (from https://console.velt.dev)"
  WAIT for user response.

STEP 3 - GET AUTH TOKEN:
  Ask ONLY: "Please provide your Velt Auth Token (from https://console.velt.dev)"
  WAIT for user response.

STEP 4 - FEATURE SELECTION (with SKIP option):
  Read the install-velt skill for the full feature list. Present ALL features from the skill to the user.
  Include SKIP as an option for CLI-only scaffolding.
  For Comments: ask which type (freestyle/popover/page/text/inline/tiptap/lexical/slate).
  For CRDT: ask which editor (tiptap/codemirror/blocknote).
  WAIT for user response.

=========================================
🚨 IF USER TYPES "SKIP": CLI-ONLY MODE 🚨
=========================================
  Call tool with ONLY: projectPath, apiKey, authToken, mode="cli-only"
  DO NOT pass features or other params. Tool returns TODO checklist. DONE.

=========================================
🔷 IF USER SELECTS FEATURES: GUIDED MODE 🔷
=========================================

  STEP 5 - VELTPROVIDER LOCATION:
    Ask: "Where should VeltProvider be installed? (app/page.tsx recommended). NOTE: ONLY recommend app/page.tsx. Do NOT suggest app/layout.tsx."
    WAIT for response.

  STEP 6 - CORNER POSITION:
    Ask: "Which corner for Velt features? (top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right)"
    WAIT for response.

  STEP 7 - FIRST TOOL CALL (runs CLI, returns status):
    Call with mode="guided", stage="plan", features, etc.
    Tool returns status="awaiting_discovery_consent"

  STEP 8 - DISCOVERY CONSENT:
    Tool response includes question about scanning codebase.
    Ask user: "Scan codebase for wiring info? [YES/NO]"
    WAIT for response.

  STEP 9A - IF USER SAYS YES (scan path):
    Call tool with discoveryConsent="yes"
    Tool returns status="awaiting_discovery_verification" with findings
    Show findings to user, ask: "Verify? [CONFIRM ALL / EDIT / UNSURE]"
    Call tool with discoveryVerification={status:"confirmed"|"edited", overrides?:{...}}

  STEP 9B - IF USER SAYS NO (manual path):
    Call tool with discoveryConsent="no"
    Tool returns status="awaiting_manual_wiring_answers" with questionnaire
    Ask questionnaire (DocumentId, User, Auth, Insertion) ONE SECTION AT A TIME
    Call tool with manualWiring={documentId:{...}, user:{...}, auth:{...}, insertion:{...}}

  STEP 10 - PLAN GENERATED:
    Tool returns status="plan_generated" with full plan
    Show plan, ask: "Would you like me to implement this?"
    WAIT for approval.

  STEP 11 - APPLY:
    Call with mode="guided", stage="apply", approved=true
    Execute plan, run full QA.

=========================================
TOOL RESPONSE STATUSES:
=========================================
• awaiting_discovery_consent - Need YES/NO for codebase scanning
• awaiting_discovery_verification - Scan done, need CONFIRM/EDIT/UNSURE
• awaiting_manual_wiring_answers - User said NO, need questionnaire answers
• plan_generated - Plan ready with verified/manual wiring
• cli_only_complete - SKIP path done
• apply_complete - Apply stage done

=========================================
CRITICAL RULES:
=========================================
• ASK ONE QUESTION AT A TIME - never batch questions
• Check tool response "status" field to know next action
• NO plan without verified scan OR completed manual answers
• If user says UNSURE, ask who can confirm - do NOT guess

projectPath.description: Path to the project directory - Must be confirmed by user

apiKey.description: Velt API Key from https://console.velt.dev - REQUIRED

authToken.description: Velt Auth Token from https://console.velt.dev - REQUIRED

mode.description: Installation mode. Use "cli-only" if user typed SKIP. Default: "guided"

stage.description: For guided mode: "plan" generates the plan, "apply" executes it. Default: "plan"

approved.description: Set to true when user approved the plan (for stage="apply").

commentType.description: Type of comments (if comments feature selected)

crdtEditorType.description: CRDT editor type (if crdt feature selected)

headerPosition.description: Corner position for Velt features. Default: "top-right"

veltProviderLocation.description: Where to install VeltProvider. Default and recommended: "app/page.tsx". Do NOT use app/layout.tsx.

discoveryConsent.description: User consent for automated codebase scanning. "yes"=run scan, "no"=use manual questionnaire.

targetArea.description: Optional: User description of where they want comments
